name: GO-NeRF
aliases: Generating Objects in Neural Radiance Fields
definition: A pipeline that generates text-prompt-controlled 3D virtual objects at user-specified locations within an existing 3D environment (represented as a NeRF), preserving unchanged scene content and maintaining compatibility with various NeRF representations.
summary: GO-NeRF generates text-controlled 3D objects at user-specified locations in existing NeRF scenes by decoupling object generation into a localized bounding box and using compositional rendering.
